facts.fact: Giant-sized, very tall and large man
Face covered with sword scars (this appears to describe another person, possibly the first elder; uncertain)
facts.quote: 얼굴 가득한 칼자국과 핏발 선 눈동자.

facts.fact: Has a huge, large build; a young man with a giant frame is said to resemble him
facts.quote: 흡사 진위경을 연상시키는 거대한 덩치의 청년

facts.fact: Has a large, sturdy frame, reminiscent of Cheol-u

facts.quote: 당당한 풍채와 자연스럽게 흘러나오는 위엄이 좌중을 압도한다.

facts.fact: Wears martial robes embroidered with a silver flying dragon
facts.quote: 은빛 비룡이 수놓아진 무복을 걸친 진위경

facts.fact: Tall even by modern standards; considered a giant in the martial world
facts.quote: 진위경은 현대의 관점에서 봐도 장신이지만, 무림에서는 거인으로 통한다.

facts.fact: Broad, massive shoulders and prominent muscles visible through clothing
facts.quote: 우랄산맥 같은 어깨와 의복 위로 도드라진 근육을

facts.fact: Not clearly stated; passage describes old carpenter's eyes, not his

ranges.description: Jin Wikyung is a giant of a man, very tall even by modern standards, with an enormous hulking frame. He has broad, massive shoulders and prominent muscles that show through his clothing. He carries himself with an imposing, dignified bearing and wears martial robes embroidered with a silver flying dragon. Tags: male, giant, very tall, hulking build, broad shoulders, muscular, imposing presence, martial robes, silver flying dragon embroidery
